definitions.gloss: the space between the eyebrows; glabella
definitions.explanation: the area of the forehead directly above the nose and between the eyebrows

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眉間|みけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しわ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せて→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{込|こ}んでいた→考え込む：21866_kangaekomu⟧。

notes:
BODY PART:
{眉間|みけん} refers specifically to the small area between the eyebrows, above the bridge of the nose.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眉間|みけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しわ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ - to furrow one's brow (showing worry, concentration, or displeasure)
- {眉間|みけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撃|う}つ→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧ - to shoot between the eyes (dramatic expression)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese face reading ({人相学|にんそうがく}), the {眉間|みけん} is considered an important area that reflects a person's fortune and character.
